# Cloud Hak

> Websites and marketing systems for UK trades. One simple price, done for you. Brighton & Hove, UK.

Cloud Hak builds websites and simple marketing systems for tradespeople and small businesses in the UK: websites that turn visitors into text messages, missed-call text-back, 5-star review funnels, one-click marketing campaigns, and Google Business Profile optimisation. Everything is set up for the client — no tech skills needed.

## Services

- **Website That Works**: A proper website that turns visitors into text conversations sent straight to your phone. Mobile-friendly, instant SMS alerts, found on Google. Included in the core plan.
- **Missed Call Text-Back**: When you miss a call, the customer gets an automatic text so the lead isn't lost. Available 24/7. Included in the core plan.
- **5-Star Review Funnel**: Automatically asks customers for Google reviews and filters out bad experiences before they go public. Included in the core plan.
- **One-Click Marketing**: Pre-built campaigns for referrals and offers. Send promotions to past customers in seconds. Included in the core plan.
- **Google Business Profile Optimisation**: Your Google listing tuned so local customers find you. Included in the core plan.
- **AI Visibility**: We check what AI assistants (ChatGPT, Google AI) say about your business, fix your visibility so you get recommended, and send monthly proof reports with screenshots. Free AI check, £297 one-off makeover, £97/month ongoing.

## Pricing

- Core plan: £297/month. No setup fee. No contract. Includes website, missed-call text-back, review funnel, one-click marketing, mobile app, Google Business Profile optimisation, and on-site SEO.
- AI Visibility: free check → £297 one-off makeover → £97/month proof reports.
- Add-ons (after onboarding): Google Ads from £297/mo, AI chatbot from £297, AI voice agent from £497, advanced SEO from £197/mo.

## Who it's for

Tradespeople and local businesses in the UK — plumbers, electricians, roofers, contractors, and similar. People who are good at their trade and don't want to think about marketing technology.
